headline: Foreign cash poured in. *Nifty still slipped*.
subline: FIIs bought Rs 5,866.78 Cr and DIIs sold. Decliners beat advancers nearly 3 to 1.
hero_text: FIIs net bought Rs 5,866.78 Cr while DIIs net sold Rs 3,159.9 Cr. The Nifty still closed 0.63% lower.

why.title: Selling had no single trigger
why.desc: No clear catalyst. Decliners outnumbered advancers by 2,035 to 693.

why.title: Metals and IT fell sharply
why.desc: Nifty Metal lost 2.46% and Nifty IT slid 1.24%.

why.title: US markets sent mixed signals
why.desc: The Dow fell 0.94% while the Nasdaq rose 0.24%.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: SBI's rise led the state lenders higher
sector_reasons.Media: Held a small bid on a red tape
sector_reasons.Pharma: Cipla's gain kept the group green
sector_reasons.Metal: Hindalco fell as the whole group sagged
sector_reasons.Auto: TMPV slipped as autos lost ground

bonus_text: Advances 693, declines 2,035. Only 15 of 50 Nifty stocks rose, so the tape was weaker than the index.
movers_note_gainers: SBI led at 2.38%. Cipla, Tata Consumer and Apollo Hospitals also rose.
movers_note_losers: Titan sank 5.30%, the deepest cut. HDFC Life, Hindalco and BSE trailed.
watch_text: Thursday: Nifty open interest stacked calls at 26,000 and puts at 24,000. Max pain sat at 25,050.
lessons: Breadth was the tell. About 3 stocks fell for every 1 that rose.
Fear did not spike. India VIX held near 15.5 on a day when decliners led.
Pockets held up inside the fall. PSU banks, media and pharma closed green while metals sank.
One pocket lagged the rest. Consumer Durables trailed while PSU Bank led.
alert_text: Lagarde speaks, US jobless claims and the Philly Fed all land at 23:00 IST on Thursday.
cta_headline: Foreign cash in, index down. *Save it for Thursday*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Thursday 19 November. The flow split is the thing to track.
next_text: Thursday 19 November is next. The Nifty option expiry sits on Monday 23 November, with max pain at 25,050.
caption_a:
FIIs bought Rs 5,866.78 Cr of cash and the Nifty still fell.
It closed at 25,227.95, down 0.63%. DIIs net sold Rs 3,159.9 Cr.
Decliners beat advancers 2,035 to 693.
Watch: Lagarde and US claims at 23:00 IST on Thursday.
